frog.head: head.frog
frog._rider_legs_doc: folded: rides with its legs folded against the flank, as it sits (not stretched down to the girth like a person's)
frog._mounts_doc: frogs ride giant newts (Dominic, D-122), in the forest too; the swamp's family mount is the newt as well, so swamp frogs never ride beetles

bonuses.text: Units 30% cheaper and train 20% faster (a swarm that breeds fast)

rat.head: head.rat
rat._mounts_doc: the creature's own mounts, ridden before the family's (rats ride alley cats, Dominic D-124; the capybara, RB1's pick, is still there for anyone who asks for it by name)
rat._unique_doc: the creature's own unique unit theme (data/uniques.json), ahead of its culture's; a theme the prompt asked for (cheese -> the Big Cheese) comes first

beetle._harness_doc: carries its weapons in a harness, no hands (its rig's carry "harness"): it clings to a mount and can't draw a bow there, so no mounted archer line (rules roster needs_hands)

bonuses.text: Hard shells: every unit +1 pierce armour

beetle.head: head.beetle
beetle._mount_body_doc: beetle soldiers rear up (BG1); ridden beetles keep the horizontal body

pony._not_ridden_by_doc: beetles don't ride horses (Dominic, 2026-10-13): they ride beetles, or spiders and newts by culture
pony.head: head.pony

bonuses.text: A horse's back: workers carry 60% more (and centaurs are quick)

cat.head: head.cat
cat._skins_not_under_doc: a grey tabby under a grey rat reads as one grey blob at game scale (like the red eft under a red frog, D-122)

newt.head: head.newt
newt._skin_weights_doc: how often each skin is picked, against 1 for the rest (fire is the usual newt, Dominic D-122)
newt._skins_not_under_doc: a mount skin never picked under a rider of these skins (a red eft under a red frog reads as one blob, D-122)
newt._voice_doc: mounts don't speak in play (a unit speaks with its race's voice); a newt is a quiet frog

hummingbird.head: head.hummingbird
hummingbird._parts_doc: parts the creature always has as a mount (its own wings), priced like any part
hummingbird._not_ridden_by_doc: creatures this mount never carries, even when asked (bugs on a hummingbird looked wrong, Dominic); they walk, with a note
hummingbird._rider_scale_doc: percent: riders of these creatures sit smaller on this mount (a frog dwarfed the hummingbird, Dominic)
